sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, travel away to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach have won seven of their ten matches and recovered from a recent loss with an earlier victory, though Alsager are struggling near the foot of the table with just one win from ten games. This should be a strong opportunity for the leaders to maintain their position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday as they look to stay in the title race, sitting just two points behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth welcome Eccleshall in a fixture between two sides in the upper half, with Bridgnorth's recent form concerning after two consecutive losses. Wolverhampton Casuals are away at Wednesfield Community on Saturday before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday 7 October, giving them two fixtures this period. Bilston Town entertain Foley Meir in a mid-table clash, while Barnton host Shawbury United—notably, Shawbury are in alarming form with six consecutive defeats. In the lower reaches, Crewe face Allscott Heath and Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills, both seeking points to climb away from the relegation zone. Cheadle Heath Nomads welcome Telford Town in a match between two of the division's lowest-placed sides, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday, with Widnes having picked up just two points from seven games so far.
